title.narrative: Feasibility study and partner search for building sustainable warehouses in Ethiopia and Sudan

description.narrative: Triple Panel Buildings is a part of the Lothe Group, consisting of 13 companies involved in construction and manufacturing in Norway with more than 50 years of experience. Lothe Group and Triple Panel Buildings have developed a technical design and business concept around concrete construction panels consisting of up to 90% reused plastic and polystyrene. They are produced locally, at lower cost and lower energy usage than competing technologies. Based on this technology, Triple Panel Buildings (TPB) will conduct feasibility studies in Ethiopia and Sudan on building affordable housing and warehouses.The project comprises of a feasibility study to identify realistic market opportunities in the countries.The feasibility studieswill provide a thorough external analysis of the potential market opportunities available in both countries, and further the landscape of possible partners and niche market opportunities within both the humanitarian sector and on local markets.
